top_signals.title: Oil Dips on Fresh Iran War Diplomacy, Talks on Hormuz
top_signals.summary: Oil extended declines as fresh diplomatic efforts helped renew hope the Iran war would not escalate, while a US plan to ramp up economic pressure on Tehran spared the country’s trading partners from harsher measures for now.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: European Stocks Rise as Pullback in Oil Lifts Investor Sentiment
top_signals.summary: European stocks gained in a choppy trading session as a pullback in oil prices eased some of the inflation and bond-market pressures that have weighed on the region in recent days.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Bolsonaro’s Strategy to Purge Top Court Faces Hurdles in Brazil
top_signals.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro’s push to elect a Senate majority willing to remove Supreme Court justices he views as enemies of his family is running into early obstacles, with opinion polls suggesting the conservative sweep he is seeking will be difficult to achieve.
